name: Kal
description: An ambitious Gruul shaman of the Zhur-Taa clan and trained hunter.

description_citations.text: "Kal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal is assigned by Nikya to spy on the Izzet near the Rubblebelt and watches them from a ruined spire.
timeline.quote: Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways to spy on the Izzet

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal secretly follows the war party to protect his friend Durri.
timeline.quote: He could not abandon his friend.

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Janik discovers Kal, but a battle with Rakdos breaks out and they join it.
timeline.quote: Kal was discovered by a warrior named Janik

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Rakdos flailer ogre wounds Kal, and he channels Izzet-style magic from rage and desperation.
timeline.quote: a Rakdos flailer ogre caught Kal's leg and sent him sprawling to the ground

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal unleashes a blast of fire that destroys the Rakdos and demons and passes out.
timeline.quote: With a blast of fire, Kal incinerated the grinning flailer.

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal wakes to learn Massacre Girl escaped and the bloodwitch was killed by his spell; he is rewarded with Durri's smile.
timeline.quote: Nikya told him that Massacre Girl had escaped

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
